title: Electricity Bill Disconnection Scam
warning: Receiving text messages warning that electricity will be cut off tonight unless you call a specific mobile number or download an app.
action: Do not call the number. Contact the official electricity board helpline directly or check your bill on the official board website.

title: Fake Customer Care Toll-Free Numbers
warning: Searching for customer care numbers on search engines can lead to fake numbers posted by scammers mimicking banks/airlines.
action: Only use customer care numbers found on official mobile apps, or printed on the back of your credit/debit cards.

title: Part-Time Job / Telegram Task Scams
warning: Promises of earning thousands daily by doing simple tasks like liking videos, followed by demands to join investment groups.
action: Never transfer money to get high-paying simple tasks. Report such groups on the social app and cybercrime portal.

title: Kaun Banega Crorepari WhatsApp Lottery
warning: Receiving audio messages and posters claiming you have won a lottery of Rs. 25 Lakh, requesting processing fees.
action: This is a 100% fake lottery scam. Do not pay any 'processing fee' or tax, and block the unknown number immediately.

title: Courier Delivery Fraud (FedEx Scam)
warning: Scammers call claiming a parcel sent by you contains illegal substances, demanding payment or bank details to avoid arrest.
action: No law agency or courier service demands online payment over a call to clear cases. Hang up and report immediately to 1930.

title: Remote Device Access App Scam
warning: Scammers ask you to download apps like AnyDesk, TeamViewer, or RustDesk under the pretext of resolving a tech support problem.
action: Downloading these apps gives complete control of your screen and OTPs to the scammer. Never install remote access apps for strangers.

title: Aadhaar Enabled Payment System (AePS) Fraud
warning: Biometric fingerprints copied from property papers or registry documents can be misused to withdraw money via AePS.
action: Lock your biometrics using the UIDAI portal or mAadhaar app. Unlock them temporarily only when you need to authenticate.

title: Fake Government Subsidy Links
warning: Messages on WhatsApp claiming government is distributing free laptops, tablets, or solar panels if you click a link and forward it.
action: Check the URL domain. Government websites always end in .gov.in or .nic.in. Do not forward such unverified viral links.

title: Urgent UPI Request Scam
warning: Scammers send UPI collect requests or QR codes, claiming that scanning the code will deposit money into your account.
action: You NEVER need to enter your UPI PIN or scan a QR code to receive money. Entering your PIN always deducts money from your account.

title: Sextortion and Video Call Blackmail
warning: Receiving video calls from unknown numbers, which are recorded with obscene footage and used to blackmail you for money.
action: Do not pick up video calls from unknown numbers. If trapped, do not pay money. File a complaint immediately with the cyber police.

title: Always check Website URLs
warning: Scam sites use look-alike domain names such as 'pm-kisan-portal.in' instead of the official 'pmkisan.gov.in'.
action: Always ensure the website domain ends with '.gov.in' or '.nic.in' before submitting personal or banking data.

title: Protect your OTP and PINs
warning: No official, bank clerk, or helpline agent is authorized to ask for your bank OTP, PIN, password, or CVV.
action: Keep OTPs confidential. If anyone asks for it, treat them as a potential scammer and end the communication.

title: Secure your Social Media Accounts
warning: Compromised social media accounts are used by hackers to send urgent borrowing requests to your friends.
action: Enable Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) on WhatsApp, Facebook, and Instagram to prevent account hijacking.

title: Use DigiLocker for Safety"
warning: Carrying physical certificates can lead to theft, damage, or loss of critical citizenship proofs.
action: Download and sign up on DigiLocker to store and present digital, legally valid copies of driving licenses, marksheets, and Aadhaar.

title: Block Spam Calls via Sanchar Saathi
warning: Spam calls and fake SIM cards registered in your name can expose you to legal risks.
action: Visit the Sanchar Saathi portal (sancharsaathi.gov.in) to check the number of active SIMs linked to your Aadhaar card.

title: Keep Device Software Updated
warning: Outdated operating systems and applications have security vulnerabilities that hackers can exploit.
action: Turn on automatic updates on your mobile phones and computers to ensure you have the latest security patches.

title: Verify Charity / Donation Appeals"
warning: Scammers set up fake crowd-funding campaigns and UPI QR codes during disasters to siphon funds.
action: Donate only to recognized national funds (like PM CARES) or certified, verified NGOs after confirming their credentials.

title: Avoid Public Wi-Fi for Banking"
warning: Public open Wi-Fi networks at stations or cafes can be intercepted to capture usernames and passwords.
action: Use your private mobile data connection or a secure VPN when logging into net banking or mobile wallets.

title: Report Lost Mobile Phones Immediately"
warning: Lost phones with active SIMs allow thieves to reset passwords and access bank accounts via OTPs.
action: Contact your telecom provider to block the SIM immediately, and register the lost device on the CEIR portal.

title: Educate Family Members on Scams"
warning: Elderly parents and young teenagers are often the softest targets for online scammers.
action: Discuss common scam tactics at home and teach them never to share card details or make urgent financial decisions under pressure.
